'''Chung Soon-yeong''' ({{Korean|hangul=정순영}}; born February 21, 1959) is a mathematics professor in the Department of Mathematics and Convergence Biomedical Engineering at [[Sogang University]]. He was the fifth president of the [[National Institute for Mathematical Sciences]]<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.nims.re.kr/intro/pageView/41 |script-title=ko:연혁 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= [[National Institute for Mathematical Sciences]] |publisher= |access-date= 17 May 2023 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.dongascience.com/news.php?idx=22507 |title= "4차 산업혁명 위해 산업수학에 정부 지원 필요해", 산업수학 심포지움 |author= 조혜인 |date= 21 May 2018 |website= [[Donga Science]] |publisher= |access-date= 26 October 2023 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref> and a vice president of the [[Korean Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.kms.or.kr/introduce/officer.html?dyear=2011 |title= 2011~2012년도 대한수학회이사 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= [[Korean Mathematical Society]] |publisher= |access-date= 26 October 2023 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref>

==Education==
Chung went to [[Yushin High School]], a private high school in [[Suwon]], entering in 1974. He focused on [[natural science]]. Entering [[Seoul National University]] in 1978, he majored in mathematics with an emphasis on [[partial differential equations]] for his PhD.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.jeonpa.co.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=45915 |script-title=ko:정순영 수리과학연구소장 취임식 개최 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date=1 February 2018 |website=전파신문 |publisher= |access-date= 26 October 2023 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref>

==Career==
After graduation, he was an assistant professor at [[Duksung Women's University]] followed by an associate professor and then full professor at Sogang University.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.kms.or.kr/eng/board/download.php?code=news&num=1540&comm=&period=&trans= |title= The Newsletter of the KMS |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= [[Korean Mathematical Society]] |publisher= |access-date= 26 October 2023 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref> From 2000, he held other positions at Sogang, including head of the Department of Mathematics, director of the Research Institute for Basic Science<!--기초과학연구소장-->,<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.hani.co.kr/arti/PRINT/61092.html |script-title=ko:9월 1일 인사 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= 31 August 2005 |website= [[The Hankyoreh]] |publisher= |access-date= 26 October 2023 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref> dean of academic affairs, director of the Teaching and Learning Center<!--교수학습센터소장-->,<ref>{{cite web |url= http://www.sg-alumni.org/page/bbs/board.php?bo_table=b03&wr_id=311&sfl=wr_subject%7C%7Cwr_content&stx=%EC%A0%95%EC%88%9C%EC%98%81&sop=and |script-title=ko:보직교수에 동문출신 11명, 특별서강 가동 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= 6 July 2009 |website= Sogang University Alumni Association |publisher= |access-date= 26 October 2023 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= http://www.sg-alumni.org/page/bbs/board.php?bo_table=b03&wr_id=288&sfl=wr_subject%7C%7Cwr_content&stx=%EC%A0%95%EC%88%9C%EC%98%81&sop=and |script-title=ko:서강을 달군 격정토론 4시간, 총장과의 대화 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= 28 October 2009 |website= Sogang University Alumni Association |publisher= |access-date= 26 October 2023 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref> dean of the College of Natural Science.<ref>{{cite web |url= http://www.jeonpa.co.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=45776 |script-title=ko:정순영 국가수리과학연구소장 취임 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= 30 January 2018 |website= 전파신문|publisher= |access-date= 26 October 2023 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref>

His service to the Korean Mathematical Society included director of the 42nd Math Olympiad,<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.kms.or.kr/board/list.html?num=1243&start=795&sort=top%20desc,%20reg_dt%20desc&code=notice&tcode=&key=&keyword= |script-title=ko:제 42회 IMO 한국대표 선발 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= [[Korean Mathematical Society]] |publisher= |access-date= 26 October 2023 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref> organizer,<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.kms.or.kr/introduce/officer.html?dyear=2005 |title= 2005–2006년도 대한수학회이사 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= [[Korean Mathematical Society]] |publisher= |access-date= 26 October 2023 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref> editing executive director,<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.kms.or.kr/introduce/officer.html?dyear=2007 |title= 2007–2008년도 대한수학회이사 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= [[Korean Mathematical Society]] |publisher= |access-date= 26 October 2023 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref> and vice president.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.edaily.co.kr/news/read?newsId=03562086619082968&mediaCodeNo=2 |script-title=ko:정순영 수리과학연구소장 취임…3년 임기 |author= 조용석 |date= 30 January 2018 |website=[[Edaily]] |publisher= |access-date= 26 October 2023 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref> For a two-year term starting in 2007, he headed the Mathematical Sciences Division at the [[National Research Foundation of Korea]].

He became the fifth president of the [[National Institute for Mathematical Sciences]] from January 30, 2018, to January 29, 2021.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.hankyung.com/it/article/201912173357i |script-title=ko:정순영 국가수리과학연구소장, 2019년 교육부 선정 이공계 우수 연구자 |author=이해성 |date= 17 December 2019 |website=[[The Korea Economic Daily]] |publisher= |access-date= 5 April 2022 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.dongascience.com/news.php?idx=44222 |script-title=ko:후보 재공모, 후보사퇴, 노조성명까지...국가수리연 진통 끝 새 소장에 김현민 교수 |author= 김우현 |date= 25 February 2021 |website=[[Donga Science]]|publisher= |access-date= 5 April 2022 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= https://math.sogang.ac.kr/front/cmsboardview.do?currentPage=1&searchField=ALL&searchValue=&searchLowItem=ALL&bbsConfigFK=1952&siteId=math&pkid=797201 |script-title=ko:정순영 교수, 제 5대 국가수리과학연구소장 취임 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= 2 February 2018|website= Mathematics Department |publisher= [[Sogang University]] |access-date= 26 October 2023 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref>

==Honors and awards==
* 2019: Outstanding Researcher in Science and Engineering, [[Ministry of Education (South Korea)|Ministry of Education]]<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.hankyung.com/article/201912173357i  |script-title=ko:정순영 국가수리과학연구소장, 2019년 교육부 선정 이공계 우수 연구자 |author= 이해성 |date= 17 December 2019 |website= [[The Korea Economic Daily]] |publisher= |access-date= 26 October 2023 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref>
* 2013: Best Lecturer of the School of Natural Sciences, Sogang University
* 2010: Fellow, [[Korean Academy of Science and Technology]]<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.kms.or.kr/eng/board/list.html?num=1591&start=75&sort=reg_dt%20asc&code=announce&tcode=&key=&keyword= |script-title=ko:[안내] 정순영 회원(서강대) 한국과학기술한림원 정회원 선출 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= 23 November 2010  |website= [[Korean Mathematical Society]] |publisher= |access-date= 26 October 2023 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref>
* 2010: Achievement Award, Korean Mathematical Society<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.kms.or.kr/eng/board/list.html?num=2159&code=news |title= 『대한수학회소식』 제134호 (2010년 11월호) |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= 30 November 2010 |website= [[Korean Mathematical Society]] |publisher= |access-date= 26 October 2023 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref>
* 2009: Alumni Award<!--수원유신고등학교 공로동문상-->, Yushin High School
* 2008: Public Relations Achievement Award<!--한국연구재단 홍보공로상-->, [[National Research Foundation of Korea]]
* 2005: Outstanding Instructor Award, Graduate School of Education, Sogang University
* 2002: LG Yonam Overseas Professor<!--LG Yonam Overseas Professor-->
* 2001–2017: Professor with Outstanding Research Achievement, Sogang University<!--서강대학교 교육대학원 우수 강사상-->
